gtabase.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

pushsquare.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

roadmap.title: Story: Chapters 1–2 — learn Leonida
roadmap.text: Play the story and do the side questlines as they open. Do the Chapter 1 meditation the morning after Down to Earth — it is the one thing that can be missed. Scan vehicles and study animals as you go; both count toward the 100% checklist later.

roadmap.title: Story: Chapters 3–5 — the crew comes together
roadmap.text: Finish the campaign and the side-character finales (Andy, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Kenton, Bret). Bank vaults, jewelry robberies and the Key Cloner unlock here — grab the secret trophies that need them (Capital Offense, Let's Go Bowling) while the tools are fresh.

roadmap.title: Free-roam: activities & collectibles
roadmap.text: Shooting ranges, drone races, races, stunts, WAiNK scans, card sets, meditation spots and map fog. Most of this feeds the 100% checklist, so work it in checklist order and let the counters do the tracking.

roadmap.title: Crime & money: robberies, fences, garages
roadmap.text: Gang operations, bank vaults, armored trucks, marked bills and spending. Robberies pay for the garages, and the garages unlock vehicle registration — do them as one money loop.

roadmap.title: Cleanup: challenges, secrets & the platinum
roadmap.text: Finish any 50 of 80 challenges (70 of 80 for the 100% checklist), mop up the UFO easter egg and the two still-unconfirmed secrets as guides confirm them, then close out the 100% checklist for A Long Road and the platinum.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Unlocks on its own once the other 54 trophies are done — there is no separate task, so finish the list and the platinum pops. No online or DLC trophies exist, so a single single-player playthrough covers it. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 at about 200 hours.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 and it pops at the end of the mission.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. It pops as Chapter 2 opens with its first mission, What's in the Bag?, so just keep playing the story.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. It pops as Chapter 3 opens with Welcome to Vice City.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. It pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. It pops after the chapter's final mission, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the game. Story trophy, cannot be missed — it pops when the credits roll.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. Story trophy, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist. Story trophy, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. Story trophy, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. Story trophy, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown. Story trophy, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory. Story trophy, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), which only appears after the story. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the list is missable. The bar is lenient — roughly 60% true completion: most side quests are optional, collectibles are only partly required, and you need 70 of 80 challenges. The only lines that demand everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Most of it will already be done by the time the other trophies are.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps, mixed however you like. Under-the-bridge flights are the fastest to rack up. Track progress per region in Progress > Activities > Stunts, and find each stunt by name on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / drone race, and performing a stunt. Check Progress > Activities to see which types you have done. Most come naturally from the story and the other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. There is no trick beyond practice — use a steady weapon, take the timed challenges at a calm pace, and retry freely. The ranges also level your Focus, which helps Gunslinger.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations (42 races in total). Each location has three races; winning one race at a location counts it. Fly the racing line, cut corners where the course allows, and retry a location until you win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts — street races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races — as long as each is a different race location. There are 40 unique race locations, so pick the easiest ones and skip the rest.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing spot marked purple on the map. Follow his fishing questline; the challenge itself is a straight fishing contest — hook fish steadily and keep the line tension in the safe zone.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game. There are four video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You must reach the end of the game; beating every challenge inside it is not required.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline, which is Lucia-only and opens in Chapter 3 when Andy calls and texts her home address in Belville. Complete all five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops after the last one. The quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline. It opens in Chapter 1 after the mission Island Dreams, when Kenton calls and is marked 'KR' in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks, marking purple chest icons on the map; use the metal detector to dig treasure from the ocean floor and bring it back. Kenton goes quiet for a stretch after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2–3 — as Jason you can speed it up by calling Brian.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline, marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete all five jobs — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops after the last. Still available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Only certain questlines count — Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile deliveries) are confirmed, with more still being found. Note that the named-character questlines (Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie) do not count. Track your count in the trophy list; all strands stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. Randy then hands you a wish list of 16 sports cars to deliver to his garage in west Vice City (green 'RK' icon); scan cars with the WAiNK app to check them against the list, steal them anywhere, and drive them back in good condition for more pay. The trophy pops when the list is complete.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline, Jason-only, opening after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers point to Synthetic Labs around Vice City — raid and destroy them in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter, then Tyrone hands you the second quest Spin On This, which pops the trophy when the labs are shut down. Still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot: 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, tracked in Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. Each spot counts twice if you meditate there with both Jason and Lucia. THE MISSABLE ONE: during Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you must follow and accept. That meditation adds +1 to your counter but is not marked as a spot, and it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy — do it anyway, because it is gone after Chapter 1. Every other spot can be done after the story; the final one needs both characters playable together (after Coffee Break, Chapter 2).

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's questline opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Jason gets a text marking Veteran Hunted in Lummox County (Jason-only). After meeting Bret he marks hunting spots on the map; hunt the animals he requests and bring them back. Bret gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker. PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed exactly which animal pops the trophy — work through his 15 Target Decks and it will come.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card sets scattered across Leonida; find every card in any 3 sets. Cards hide in shops, buildings and the open world — check a card-set location guide for each set and grab sets as you pass through areas.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK It locations: hold Up then R1 to scan landmarks (31), curiosities (35), sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags. Any 100 count, and there are far more than 100 in the world — scan everything you walk past and it pops on its own.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. Track them in Progress > Challenges. You need 70 of 80 for the 100% checklist, so this pops on the way — finish the easy challenges last and skip the hardest ten.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you. Available after Coffee Break (Chapter 2), when you can call your partner with Right + Triangle. Cause carnage until you hit 4 stars, then escape the red heat zone — a fast sports bike through traffic works, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is the easy route, since cops struggle on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…, when bank vault robberies hand you 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. After Coffee Break, call your partner, then hit 3 robbery targets (green map icons) while the red/blue flashing wanted level stays up — do not let it drop to the red heat level or clear. Wear armor, carry sticky bombs and healing items, and loot a couple of items plus the back-room safe in each shop. The pop is delayed by about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop; if it does not fire, hit a fourth. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, Chapter 3) are a good run.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Hold Up to open the WAiNK app, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive it. Stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic. You need 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles for the 100% checklist, so this pops on the way. Check totals in Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3+R3 while aiming; it slows time and highlights weak spots, draining the purple focus bar. Buff focus first with food, drinks or Adrenaline, wear body armor, and use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. Line up 5 enemies at a gang operation and drop them without missing. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels — raise it via shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — and it gets much easier at level 4.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA and fly it away. It must be a plane connected to a boarding bridge, not one parked on the airfield — the easiest is at terminals E3/E4. Drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge straight into the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly at least 1 km from the airport and the trophy pops (slightly delayed).

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. Tanks stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb into a Rhino, and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun and marks jewelry robberies (green icons). Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it in, find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. The trophy pops shortly after you leave.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe), which teaches the routine: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag of cash. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (purple icons) — you must first do his two Payday Loans jobs. Each vault instantly gives 4 stars, so escape on a fast bike and switch cars to break the heat. There are 8 large bank jobs; the 100% checklist wants all 8.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically in the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…, since robbing a bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck. Earlier method: block an armored truck near a bank in Vice City, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it open — sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests — then escape the red heat radius.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Unfog the whole map of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the map is fully visible. A plane is available early in Chapter 1, so you can start clearing fog between missions.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Operations are marked by yellow icons when you go near them, and many are marked automatically by story progress; track per-gang progress in Progress > Gangs. You need all 39 operations for the 100% checklist, so this pops on the way.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it while standing next to the bar. The trophy pops as you drink with the view. Confirmed by PowerPyx's post-release guide (19 Nov 2026, with screenshots) and GTABase.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window — a nod to the Banshee in GTA III. You can only take it after getting the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. Hack in, drive forward through the glass, and keep driving; the pop is slightly delayed. Only the blue Banshee works.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a Kolt & Associates gang operation. Go during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, with sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation (you need them for the safe). The three items: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway. The trophy pops after you escape the police. If you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns after a while and you can grab the rest later — it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check Strength in Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > select a character. Available after Coffee Break (Chapter 2), when you can switch between both characters. Buy a gym membership, always work out together — call your partner with Right + Triangle — and while one trains, the other progresses too. Filter for fitness clubs on the map under Activities.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Watch the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list, and turn on criminal profile notifications in Settings > UI > HUD Notifications so a demon-face icon flags each counted action. Robberies, stealthy objectives, destroying evidence and clean escapes count as Professional; wounding without killing counts as Hardened; killing counts as Violent. It builds passively across the other trophies — if it is still short at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops, but avoid pushing into the permanent Irredeemable profile.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no guide has pinned down the trigger yet (checked 20 Nov 2026). PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue; GTABase likewise says the exact steps are unconfirmed. The description — 'Second time's the charm' — suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt, possibly tied to a Payday Loans robbery. Do not chase it blindly: play the story and the Payday Loans jobs, and check the sources below for updates as players crack it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. At night after 2 AM, go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back until it spawns. Follow the path from the car into the woods and you will see the UFO (bright blue light in the sky). Approach it; it drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside as she asks — the trophy pops. The spawn is slightly random, so it may take a few tries.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no guide has pinned down the trigger yet (checked 20 Nov 2026). PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle; GTABase says the exact steps are unconfirmed. The description — 'Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by' — points to knocking people down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, most likely a kick from a motorcycle. Try drive-by kicks from a bike at pedestrians, but treat it as a lead, not a method, until a source confirms it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts (cumulative, not in one trip). First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. Bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 per robbery, and the total builds naturally across the robberies the 100% checklist requires.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops (cumulative). Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest, since they are the priciest — there are 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores to spend in.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (there are 4 more story garages that do not count). They cost $160,000 in total and go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone — buy them through the app. Robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4, are the fastest way to fund them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app installs after the Chapter 2 mission Moses; it lets you register stolen cars and have them delivered anywhere. First buy enough garages (see Little Boxes) — each adds parking spots. Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray then Register in his garage. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register standard-tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
